subject: Quick thought on the Regency Dental site / Omaha
body:
Hi Regency Dental team,

I live in the area and was checking out your practice online. It is great to see how dedicated you are to providing patient-centered care and comprehensive services like preventive cleanings and restorative implants for families around Omaha.

While browsing your current site, I noticed a couple of missed opportunities that might be slowing down patient inquiries. Specifically, adding a direct click-to-call button in the mobile header and incorporating stronger local schema markup would make it much easier for local patients to reach you quickly from their phones.

I went ahead and built a modern, clean prototype for your practice to show how these adjustments look in practice: https://nayom-biz-0x8793f2cbf7626411-0xb488fbba9c719e0.vercel.app

Feel free to check out the live preview there. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for five minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a click-to-call phone number in the mobile header
Improved local search markup and lead booking CTAs
